title: XPeng's A868 tilt milestone pushes China's flying-car race into long-range aviation
html:
As China's technological ambitions expand further into physical AI and advanced mobility, competition is increasingly moving beyond short-range low-altitude demonstrations toward more complex forms of long-range electric aviation.

Credit: Screenshot from XPeng's website.
